facts.eve: Eve was the first woman, created by God as Adam's wife.
facts.job: Job was a righteous man who suffered greatly and kept his faith.
facts.eli: Eli was a priest and judge who raised the prophet Samuel.
facts.dan: Dan was a son of Jacob and the ancestor of one of Israel's tribes.
facts.ham: Ham was a son of Noah who survived the great flood with his family.
facts.lot: Lot was Abraham's nephew who escaped the destruction of Sodom.
facts.gad: Gad was a son of Jacob and the ancestor of one of Israel's tribes.
facts.asa: Asa was a king of Judah known for removing idol worship.
facts.adam: Adam was the first man created by God in the Garden of Eden.
facts.noah: Noah built an ark to save his family and animals from a flood.
facts.abel: Abel was Adam's son, a shepherd killed by his brother Cain.
facts.cain: Cain was Adam's son who killed his brother Abel out of jealousy.
facts.ruth: Ruth was a loyal Moabite woman who became an ancestor of David.
facts.esau: Esau was Isaac's son who sold his birthright to his brother Jacob.
facts.saul: Saul was the first king of Israel, later succeeded by David.
facts.mary: Mary was the mother of Jesus, chosen to bear God's Son.
facts.john: John was a disciple of Jesus and author of a Gospel.
facts.joel: Joel was an Old Testament prophet who called people to repent.
facts.amos: Amos was a shepherd who became a prophet calling for justice.
facts.ezra: Ezra was a priest who led the Jews back from exile to Jerusalem.
facts.leah: Leah was Jacob's first wife and the mother of six of his sons.
facts.levi: Levi was a son of Jacob whose descendants became the priestly tribe.
facts.seth: Seth was a son of Adam and Eve, born after Abel's death.
facts.anna: Anna was an elderly prophetess who recognized the infant Jesus.
facts.mark: Mark was a Gospel writer who traveled with Paul and Barnabas.
facts.luke: Luke was a physician who wrote a Gospel and the book of Acts.
facts.paul: Paul was an apostle who spread the Christian faith across Rome.
facts.boaz: Boaz was a kind landowner who married Ruth.
facts.moses: Moses led the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt.
facts.david: David was a shepherd who became Israel's greatest king.
facts.jesus: Jesus is the central figure of Christianity, believed to be God's Son.
facts.peter: Peter was a fisherman who became a leading apostle of Jesus.
facts.james: James was an apostle and brother of Jesus who led the Jerusalem church.
facts.sarah: Sarah was Abraham's wife and the mother of Isaac in old age.
facts.isaac: Isaac was the promised son of Abraham and Sarah.
facts.jacob: Jacob was Isaac's son whose name was changed to Israel.
facts.aaron: Aaron was Moses' brother and the first high priest of Israel.
facts.jonah: Jonah was a prophet who was swallowed by a great fish.
facts.hosea: Hosea was a prophet whose marriage symbolized God's love for Israel.
facts.micah: Micah was a prophet who called Israel to justice and humility.
facts.nahum: Nahum was a prophet who foretold the fall of Nineveh.
facts.silas: Silas was a companion of Paul on his missionary journeys.
facts.titus: Titus was a companion of Paul who led the church in Crete.
facts.enoch: Enoch was a man who walked closely with God before being taken up.
facts.laban: Laban was Jacob's uncle and the father of Leah and Rachel.
facts.rahab: Rahab was a woman in Jericho who helped Israelite spies escape.
facts.naomi: Naomi was Ruth's mother-in-law who returned to Bethlehem with her.
facts.herod: Herod was a king who ruled Judea during the time of Jesus' birth.
facts.joseph: Joseph was sold into slavery by his brothers but rose to power in Egypt.
facts.samuel: Samuel was a prophet who anointed Israel's first two kings.
facts.elijah: Elijah was a prophet who confronted the prophets of Baal.
facts.esther: Esther was a Jewish queen who saved her people from destruction.
facts.isaiah: Isaiah was a major prophet who foretold judgment and hope.
facts.daniel: Daniel was a faithful man who survived being thrown into a lions' den.
facts.joshua: Joshua led the Israelites into the Promised Land after Moses.
facts.gideon: Gideon was a judge who defeated Israel's enemies with a small army.
facts.martha: Martha was a friend of Jesus known for her hospitality.
facts.thomas: Thomas was a disciple who doubted Jesus' resurrection until he saw him.
facts.andrew: Andrew was a fisherman who became one of Jesus' twelve disciples.
facts.philip: Philip was one of the twelve disciples of Jesus.
facts.rachel: Rachel was Jacob's beloved wife and the mother of Joseph.
facts.miriam: Miriam was the sister of Moses who watched over him as a baby.
facts.hannah: Hannah prayed for a son and became the mother of Samuel.
facts.elisha: Elisha was a prophet who succeeded Elijah and performed many miracles.
facts.josiah: Josiah was a young king of Judah who renewed worship of God.
facts.samson: Samson was a judge of Israel known for his great strength.
facts.reuben: Reuben was Jacob's firstborn son and the ancestor of a tribe.
facts.simeon: Simeon was a devout man who blessed the infant Jesus in the temple.
facts.abraham: Abraham was the father of the Hebrew nation, called by God to Canaan.
facts.solomon: Solomon was David's son, known for his wisdom and building the temple.
facts.ezekiel: Ezekiel was a prophet who had visions while exiled in Babylon.
facts.matthew: Matthew was a tax collector who became a disciple and Gospel writer.
facts.stephen: Stephen was the first Christian martyr, stoned for his faith.
facts.timothy: Timothy was a young pastor mentored by the apostle Paul.
facts.deborah: Deborah was a judge and prophetess who led Israel to victory.
facts.delilah: Delilah was the woman who betrayed Samson to the Philistines.
facts.goliath: Goliath was a giant Philistine warrior defeated by young David.
facts.lazarus: Lazarus was a friend of Jesus who was raised from the dead.
facts.gabriel: Gabriel was an angel who announced the births of John and Jesus.
facts.rebekah: Rebekah was Isaac's wife and the mother of Jacob and Esau.
facts.obadiah: Obadiah was a prophet who pronounced judgment on Edom.
facts.malachi: Malachi was the last Old Testament prophet, calling for renewed faith.
facts.jezebel: Jezebel was a queen who promoted idol worship in Israel.
facts.zebedee: Zebedee was a fisherman and the father of James and John.
facts.absalom: Absalom was David's son who rebelled against his father.
facts.ephraim: Ephraim was a son of Joseph and ancestor of a tribe of Israel.
facts.ishmael: Ishmael was Abraham's son through Hagar, ancestor of many nations.
facts.michael: Michael is an archangel described as a protector of God's people.
